description: Pre-built AI workflow templates for dental practices

workflows.name: Smart Appointment Reminders
workflows.description: Connect PMS appointment data to SMS/email — personalized reminders that reduce no-shows
steps: Pull upcoming appointments from PMS API
Check patient communication preferences
Generate personalized reminder with appointment details
Send via preferred channel (SMS, email, or both)
Handle confirmations and reschedule requests
Update PMS with confirmation status
prerequisites: Practice management system with API (Dentrix, Open Dental, Curve)

workflows.name: Automated Insurance Pre-Verification
workflows.description: Pull patient insurance details before visit — verify coverage and flag issues
workflows.trigger: Patient appointment booked for next business day
steps: Pull next-day appointments from PMS
Extract patient insurance details from records
Query insurance portal API for coverage verification
Flag coverage issues or missing information
Generate pre-visit insurance summary for front desk
Alert staff about patients needing updated insurance

workflows.name: AI-Powered Patient Recall
workflows.description: Identify patients overdue for visits and send personalized recall messages
workflows.trigger: Patient passes recall date without booking
steps: Query PMS for patients past their recall date
Segment by overdue duration and treatment type
Generate personalized recall message with Claude
Send via patient's preferred channel
Track response and escalate non-responders
Book appointments directly from patient replies

workflows.name: AI Treatment Plan Presentation
workflows.description: Generate patient-friendly treatment plan explanations from clinical notes
workflows.trigger: Dentist completes treatment plan in PMS
steps: Extract treatment plan details from PMS
Translate clinical terminology to patient-friendly language
Generate visual treatment timeline
Include cost breakdown with insurance coverage
Send to patient portal or email for review before visit
Track acceptance rates and follow up on pending plans

workflows.name: Online Review & Reputation Management
workflows.description: Automatically request reviews from satisfied patients post-appointment, monitor online reputation across platforms, and flag negative sentiment for immediate response
steps: Detect appointment completion in PMS
Check patient satisfaction score or NPS from post-visit survey
For satisfied patients (score 8+), send personalized review request via SMS/email
Include direct Google Business Profile review link
Monitor incoming reviews across Google, Yelp, Healthgrades
Flag negative reviews (< 3 stars) for immediate staff response
Generate weekly reputation summary with trends and actionable insights
prerequisites: Practice management system with checkout tracking

workflows.name: Patient Intake & Forms Digitization
workflows.description: Send digital intake forms to new patients before their first visit, pre-populate known data from insurance verification, and sync completed forms directly into the PMS
steps: Detect new patient appointment booking in PMS
Generate personalized digital intake form package (medical history, insurance, consent)
Pre-populate fields with data from insurance pre-verification if available
Send intake forms via email/SMS with secure link to patient portal
Track form completion status and send reminders for incomplete forms
On completion, validate data and sync directly into PMS patient record
Flag missing or inconsistent information for front desk review before appointment
prerequisites: Digital forms platform or patient portal
